item.title: Senegal Christians mark All Saints' Day
item.description: The feast honours all saints in the Christian faith, reminding believers of their call to holiness.

item.title: Louga police seize 7 kg of cannabis

item.title: Senegal assembly rejects finance bill again
item.description: The finance committee voted down the revised 2026 budget for a second time, delaying its passage.

item.title: Senegal forum links sport, health, and agriculture
item.description: African food systems forum in Dakar highlights maternal health and nutrition challenges.

item.title: Faye calls for lasting legacy from Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
item.description: Senegal's president urged investment in sport as a tool for economic and social development.
